verdict.rationale: React is a UI rendering library for building components, so scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is outside its product category. The evidence describes components, rendering, hydration and a build-time compiler, with nothing resembling job scheduling. The community remark about React 'scheduling DOM updates' refers to internal render prioritization, not recurring jobs, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
